author: A.J. Evans
title: Dirt bike crash leaves man, toddler hurt in Grand Haven Township - NewsBreak
text:
By A.J. Evans ,
4 hours ago
GRAND HAVEN TOWNSHIP, Mich. (WOOD) — A man and a 1-year-old girl were injured after a crash involving a dirt bike and a truck Wednesday evening in Grand Haven Township, deputies say.
The crash happened at around 6:05 p.m., according to the Ottawa County Sheriff’s Office. Deputies say a 25-year-old man was riding an electric dirt bike with a 1-year-old passenger. The two were headed east on a bike path on Mercury Drive near 148th Avenue when a Ford pickup truck leaving a nearby parking lot collided with the bike, according to the sheriff’s office.
Both the bike and the truck were traveling at low speeds at the time of the crash, deputies said.
The man and the child on the dirt bike were not wearing helmets, deputies said. The child suffered minor injuries. The 25-year-old had serious injuries after the crash. Both were hospitalized.
The driver of the truck, a 28-year-old man, was not injured.
